messages:
kyle: heads-up starting rolling release for api-service v2.14.3 in the 21:00 UTC change window. canary 5% for 10m. observability changes included (kvcache adjustments). watch p50/p95 and error-rate panels.
deploy-bot: rollout initiated — target: api-service:v2.14.3, canary=5%, regions=[global], duration=10m, commit=abcd1234
anjali: on it. I'll keep an eye on p95 and tail latencies for /v1/generate and the prefix cache hit rate. setting a sampling dashboard for traces.
mike: adding temporary smoke alert: if p95 > 420ms for 3m OR increase in 5xx rate > 0.5% for 2m, auto-pause and notify #eng-oncall.
opsbot: alert rule created: eng-releases/smoke-canary-p95 (threshold=420ms, window=3m)
(2m later)
opsbot: alert: eng-releases/smoke-canary-p95 triggered — api-service p95=472ms over 3m; region=eu-west; traces sampling link: https://traces/redwood/abcd
anjali: seeing kvcache miss spike from 6% -> 28% at the same time, KV cache GC ops increased in the logs.
tomas: digging into node metrics: host gpu-util stable, but we have high mem churn on prefix cache. suspect small change in model tokenization causing cache fragmentation.
mike: given the SLO hit in eu-west, propose pinning eu-west back to v2.14.2 while leaving global canary paused. quick decision? :thinking_face:
kyle: agree. pin eu-west to v2.14.2 and pause rest of rollout. want to avoid full rollback yet if we can isolate region.
deploy-bot: pausing rollout (manual pause by kyle). canary remains at 5% (global), no new traffic to v2.14.3 in eu-west.
anjali: running quick pin: `rbw release pin --version v2.14.2 --region eu-west --reason "canary p95 spike kvcache"`
deploy-bot: pin command accepted, rollout for eu-west reverted to v2.14.2, commit=prev_9f8e
opsbot: post-action check: eu-west p95 back to 210ms within 4m, 5xx rate normalized. SLO gap closing.
mike: good. open item: create a targeted test reproducer for the kvcache fragmentation and add to preflight for the next patch. I'll file a short release note blurb.
kyle: i'll update release notes and change-window notes: mark v2.14.3 paused and include mitigation steps and timeline. thanks all — nice triage.
anjali: leaving a bookmark to replay traces and attach trace ids to the ticket. cc: @sre for follow-up TTL settings.
mike: thumbs up :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: thread closed by manual confirm (kyle) — rollout paused, eu-west pinned, follow-ups: ENG-1234 (reproducer) and RELNOTES-88 (notes)
